name: English
_doc: Spoken prompts as DATA (PLAN.md §5.2). Tone rules from PLAN.md §7: short, one clause per sentence, respectful, never 'customer', no jargon — 'NSQF level 3' is spoken as 'a level 3 skill course'. Max 4 options spoken at once (RULE 7).

consent.line: Your information will be recorded only for skill advice and scheme linkage. You can stop at any time by saying 'stop'.
consent.detail: We will not ask for your name. Giving a phone number is not required.
consent.question: Shall we continue?
consent.granted_ack: Thank you. I will now ask five short questions.
consent.declined_ack: That is fine. None of your information has been kept. Thank you.

language_select.help: You can speak or tap to choose.

profile_district.prompt: Which district do you live in?
profile_district.help: Say the district name or pick it from the list.

profile_age_band.prompt: Which age group are you in?

profile_gender.prompt: Are you female, male, or other?
profile_gender.help: This is asked to track the share reserved for women.

profile_education.help: This decides which course will suit you.

profile_current_work.prompt: What work do you do now?

aspiration.prompt: What work would you like to learn? Please say it aloud.
aspiration.help: For example — tailoring, beauty parlour, mobile repair.
aspiration.record_hint: Press the mic and speak. Up to fifteen seconds.

clarify.prompt: I did not catch that clearly.
clarify.help: Did you mean one of these?

recommendation.prompt: This course seems the best fit for you.
recommendation.help: You can hear it again or look at other options.

summary.help: You can read this or show it to your officer.

menu_mode.prompt: The audio is not coming through clearly. Please choose using the buttons.
menu_mode.help: Press the number shown beside each option.

end.prompt: Thank you. Have a good day.
end.help: You can start again whenever you like.

recommendation.primary_intro: The course that fits you best is {course}.
recommendation.level_phrase: This is a level {level} skill course.
recommendation.centre_phrase: There are {seats} seats available in your district.
recommendation.no_centre_phrase: There is no seat information for your district yet.
recommendation.assistance_phrase: Afterwards, to start your own work you may receive loan support — {assistance}.
recommendation.women_note: At least thirty percent of seats are reserved for women.
recommendation.next_step: Ask about this course at your district skill centre.
recommendation.stretch_note: This course is a little above your current education, but you can do it.

summary.title: Your skill suggestion
summary.disclaimer: This is AI guidance. Please confirm with your officer before acting on it.

errors.asr_empty: Sorry, I could not hear that clearly. You can also tap a button to answer.
errors.network_error: There is a network problem. Please try again in a moment.
errors.db_unavailable: Our information is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.consent_required: Your consent is needed before we continue.
errors.session_not_found: That conversation was not found. Please start again.
errors.out_of_scope: I do not have that information. I can connect you to an officer.
errors.provider_unavailable: The voice service is unavailable, so we are showing this as text.
errors.rate_limited: That was too fast. Please wait a minute and speak again.
errors.no_match: I could not find a course matching what you said. I can connect you to an officer.

ui.beta_notice: This is a beta AI assistant. It can make mistakes — please confirm with your officer.
ui.offline_notice: No internet — your conversation is running offline.
